fact: The Ministry of Health and Human Services' Quarterly Health Statistics Bulletin, July-September 2023, published December 2023 (figures cover Q3 2023), draws on routine health data from health facilities in the DHIS2 HMIS, e.g. 579 reporting facilities, 1,685,815 OPD consultations and 71,607 live births in facilities.

The Ministry issues the bulletin quarterly (this is the Quarter 3, 2023 edition, published December 2023) from routine DHIS2 health data and says it will work to improve private-hospital coverage in subsequent editions.

The Somalia National Bureau of Statistics published its Statistical Abstract 2024 (first edition, compiled November 2024; figures cover mostly 2018-2023), which states that it draws on administrative records from line ministries and agencies, naming the Ministry of Education (school enrolment), the Office of the Attorney General and the courts (criminal and court cases, 2022), the Immigration and Citizenship Agency (passenger movements, 2023), the Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Livestock, Forestry and Range; as_of is the document's published date, November 2024.
